destinations.name: Mumbai to Goa
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to May. Mumbai–Goa sailings usually pause during the monsoon (June–September).

packages.title: Mumbai to Goa by Cruise with Goa Beach Stay 3N/4D
packages.summary: Arrive in Goa by sea, two days of beaches and Old Goa, no long road journey.
highlights: two days of beaches and Old Goa

itinerary.title: Board the Cruise at Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach the Mumbai cruise terminal in the afternoon for check-in and boarding. Watch the city skyline as the ship sails out, then enjoy dinner and the evening shows on board. Overnight on the ship.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Goa – North Goa Beaches
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board and disembark at Mormugao port. Transfer to your North Goa hotel (about 1 hr). Afternoon at Fort Aguada and evening on Calangute and Baga beaches. Overnight stay in North Goa.

itinerary.title: Goa Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast. Visit the UNESCO-listed churches of Old Goa, walk through the Latin Quarter of Fontainhas in Panjim, and end the day at Miramar beach and the Dona Paula viewpoint. Optional Mandovi river cruise in the evening (own cost). Overnight stay in North Goa.

itinerary.title: Departure from Goa
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check-out. Drop at Goa airport (Dabolim or Mopa) or Madgaon / Thivim railway station for your return journey. Tour ends.

notes.heading: Sightseeing
lines: Mumbai harbour sail-away, Fort Aguada, Candolim, Calangute and Baga beaches, Old Goa churches, Fontainhas, Miramar, Dona Paula.

notes.heading: Activities

notes.heading: Meals

notes.heading: Package basis
lines: Per person on twin sharing (interior cabin + 3★ hotel), minimum 2 adults. One-way cruise Mumbai → Goa, then 2 nights in Goa; return from Goa by flight or train at own cost (can be booked on request).

notes.heading: Customisation
lines: Yes – dates, hotel category, number of nights, vehicle, sightseeing and meal plan can be changed. Flights or trains can be added on request. Final price confirmed by the S2 Holidays team.

notes.heading: Best time to visit
lines: October to May. Mumbai–Goa sailings usually pause during the monsoon (June–September).

notes.heading: Important notes
lines: Prices are indicative starting prices and may change with season, hotel availability and group size. Exact hotel names, final price and availability are confirmed by the S2 Holidays team before booking. Sailing dates, port times and cabin prices are set by the cruise line and change by season; the S2 team confirms the exact sailing before booking. Carry original government photo ID (passport / Aadhaar) for boarding; report at the cruise terminal 3–4 hours before departure. One-way Mumbai → Goa sailings run only on selected dates – if none fits your dates, the team will suggest the round-trip cruise or another option.

packages.title: Mumbai – Goa – Lakshadweep Cruise 4N/5D
packages.summary: Goa and the Lakshadweep lagoons in one voyage, a full day at sea.
highlights: Goa and the Lakshadweep lagoons in one voyage

itinerary.title: Board the Cruise at Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach the Mumbai cruise terminal for check-in and boarding. Sail out of Mumbai harbour in the evening; dinner and shows on board. Overnight on the ship.

itinerary.title: Goa Port Call
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. The ship docks in Goa for the day (as per the schedule): join an optional shore excursion to Old Goa or a beach, or enjoy the ship. Overnight on the ship.

itinerary.title: Day at Sea
itinerary.description: A full day at sea – pools, live music, kids' club, games and evening shows (as per the ship). Overnight on the ship.

itinerary.title: Lakshadweep Port Call
itinerary.description: The ship anchors off a Lakshadweep island and guests go ashore by tender boat (weather permitting). Enjoy the turquoise lagoon; snorkelling or glass-bottom boat at own cost. Back on board in the evening. Overnight on the ship.

itinerary.title: Return to Mumbai
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board and disembark at Mumbai cruise terminal (as per the sailing schedule – some sailings include a further day at sea). Tour ends.
